In [[category theory]], a branch of [[mathematics]], a ''C''-'''indexed category''' is a [[pseudofunctor]] from ''C''<sup>''op''</sup> to '''Cat''',<ref>{{nlab|id=indexed+category|title=Indexed category}}</ref> where '''Cat''' is a [[Strict_2-category|2-category]] of categories. Any indexed category has an associated [[Grothendieck construction]], which gives rise to a [[fibred category]].
